name: Packaging level code
description: Code specifying a level of packaging.

values.name: Inner
values.description: Inner Level of packing, if it exists, that is immediately subordinate to the intermediate packaging level.

values.name: Intermediate
values.description: Intermediate Level of packaging, if it exists, that is immediately subordinate to the outer packaging level.

values.name: Outer
values.description: Outer For packed merchandise, outermost level of packaging for a shipment.

values.name: No packaging hierarchy
values.description: No packaging hierarchy There is no specifiable level of packaging: packaging is inner and outer level as well.

values.name: Shipment level
values.description: Shipment level The packaging level being described is the shipment level.
